content: Plan: 1) Check for workspace clippy config / [lints] table. 2) cargo fmt --all -- --check, then apply if needed. 3) cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings (workspace baseline). 4) Tighten: -W clippy::pedantic -W clippy::nursery as a second pass, report findings without auto-fixing (pedantic often has false positives that need human judgment).
